column1: # Regression set (scripts/bact_core.sh): 17 datasets from the lists named, about 10 minutes with 3
# runs at once, each chosen for a behaviour a change could break. All are development data: they
# guard against regressions and say nothing about unseen data.
# - bburg_gmt0122: B. burgdorferi (R10.4.1 sup v5.2.0), hairpin-ended linear replicons and the cp32
#   plasmid family; scored against its reference plus the 5 plasmids it lacks
# - cdiff_nctc12727: a 34.5 kb repeat no read spans [fresh]
# - kpneu_1, sflex_1, linno_1, prett_1: Autocycler-paper subsets, small and high-copy plasmids, motifs, homopolymers [subsets]
# - tbrockianus: dimer plasmid in the reference; mrhizoxinica, dsonorensis_kr87: recent R10 isolates, 2 and 6 replicons [more]
# - atenax_tsd302: reads of 1.3 kb N50, tandem plasmid copies [more]
# - psia_lmg24279, sone_mr1: genomes where Flye + Medaka is ahead [fresh]
# - HiFi: bcereus_971_hifi, ecoli_h10407_hifi (6 replicons), saureus_usa300_hifi (shallow plasmids),
#   tdenticola_a_hifi (54 kb element both integrated and excised) [more]
